scripts.dev: npm run build -w @verdant/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w @verdant/api" "npm run dev -w @verdant/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @verdant/shared && npm run build -w @verdant/api && npm run build -w @verdant/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @verdant/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @verdant/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
